description: Source code for CryptoPlugin class implementing DRM decryption and related functionalities in the Android Open Source Project, specifically for ClearKey DRM plugin.

classes.name: CryptoPlugin
classes.description: Implementation of DRM CryptoPlugin handling decryption, logging, session management, and buffer setup.

classes.name: SharedBufferBase
classes.description: Manages memory mapping of shared buffers for DRM operations.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of input buffers based on the specified mode, handling secure and non-secure buffers, subsamples, and different encryption modes.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Returns log messages; currently not implemented, returns a placeholder log.

methods.name: notifyResolution
methods.description: Notifies the plugin of video resolution changes; currently a no-op.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoderComponent
methods.description: Indicates whether a secure decoder component is required for a given MIME type; currently always false.

methods.name: setMediaDrmSession
methods.description: Associates a DRM session with the plugin based on session ID.

methods.name: setSharedBufferBase
methods.description: Sets the base address for shared buffers used in decryption.
